#check @S1280Place
#check @S1280Selection

  constructor
  intro a b
  have key : ∀ u : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ,
      (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 1 := by
    intro u
    have hmul : ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) *
        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)) = 1 :=
      Units.mul_inv u
    have hta : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) *
        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid))).toAdd = 0 := by
      rw [hmul]
      rfl
    rw [toAdd_mul] at hta
    have hx : (((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
      ((u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd.property
    have hy : ((((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).toAdd : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=

  exact (key a).trans (key b).symm

    Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)ˣ := by
  change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ)
  infer_instance

    Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v) := by
  change Subsingleton (TimesMuQuotient ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)ˣ)
  constructor
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective x
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective y
  haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)ˣ := by
    change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ)
    infer_instance
  rw [Subsingleton.elim u w]

example (D : S1895PaperInput) (P : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV)
    (h : Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P)) (v : PaperV) :
    Subsingleton (P.timesMu v) := by
  obtain ⟨phi⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨psi, hpsi⟩ := SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism.representative_exists phi
  haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v) := by
    change Subsingleton (TimesMuQuotient ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)ˣ)
    constructor
    intro x y
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective x
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective y
    haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)ˣ := by
      change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)ˣ)
      infer_instance
    rw [Subsingleton.elim u w]
  constructor
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := (psi.isoTimesMu v).surjective x
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := (psi.isoTimesMu v).surjective y
  rw [Subsingleton.elim x' y']

-- 6. weight of the bad base place is log 5
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    IUTIVPlace.weight (PaperFmod D) (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D b)) = Real.log 5 := by
  have hplace : b.1 = concreteGaussianFivePlace := by
    have hb := S1527_bad_val_eq D.l b
    rw [show S1280Place D.l = concreteGaussianFivePlace from rfl] at hb
    exact hb
  show Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (paperBadBasePlace D b).asIdeal : ℝ) = Real.log 5
  have hbase : paperBadBasePlace D b = concreteGaussianFivePlace.maximalIdeal := by
    unfold paperBadBasePlace
    rw [hplace]
  rw [hbase]
  have habs : Ideal.absNorm (concreteGaussianFivePlace.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) = 5 := by
    rw [Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]
    simpa [NumberFieldFinitePlace.ResidueField, NumberFieldFinitePlace.underlyingPrime]
      using concreteGaussianFivePlaceResidueField_card
  rw [habs]
  norm_num

end Probe1968
